pokedexEntries.di: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

pokedexEntries.prl: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

pokedexEntries.pt: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

pokedexEntries.bw: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

pokedexEntries.sw: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

pokedexEntries.sh: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

pokedexEntries.la: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.
